folders.description: Folders a file's coupled neighbours must span.

neighbourCoupling.description: At most this percent of cross-folder neighbour pairs may be coupled with each other.

clusterMinFolders.description: Folders a component must span to be a cluster finding.

population.description: The logical changes coupling was counted over.

note.description: Set when no cluster forms. The guidelines are never lowered.

path.description: The first file of the cluster in byte order, for ordering.

score.description: Folders times spread times mean degree as a fraction: how many folders a change reaches, how far apart, and how reliably.

folders.description: Distinct folders the files sit in, as they are now.

spread.description: Mean pairwise tree distance over the cluster's files.

meanDegree.description: Mean degree, in percent, of the coupled pairs inside the cluster.

files.description: The cluster's files in byte order.

magnets.description: Files of the cluster with a star shape: coupled to files in many folders which rarely change with each other.

weakestSupport.description: The lowest support among those pairs.

clearsMinimum.description: The weakest support reaches the configured cochange.minSupport, whatever --min-support listed.
